methodSelected: Temporarily isolate publishing to the bootstrap repository by disabling other token-issuing paths and restricting credentials that can alter or reopen those paths.
rationale: Official documentation provides repository Actions controls, app repository scoping and app suspension. No documented personal-namespace precreation candidate-name reservation was established. Default GITHUB_TOKEN read permission or workflow concurrency alone is not a namespace-wide deny.

sequence.action: Read actual detailed scopes and repository access for the two observed fine-grained tokens and two installed apps, plus authorized app grants and bootstrap write principals.

Build a concrete minimal before/after permission diff. Disable Actions on only enabled non-bootstrap token-issuing repositories; restrict only proven principals able to alter bootstrap workflow/policy/refs, dispatch or reenable an alternative publisher, or create a new repository that bypasses the restricted inventory.
Record restoration values and obtain user approval for those exact changes.
After approved controls are applied, establish expiry or revocation of already issued publisher tokens. Do not treat a settings toggle alone as immediate token revocation.
Review remaining owner/session and credential-minting paths. If exclusivity is still not technically established, keep BLOCKED. Do not populate a true attestation from unknown facts.
Only after technical control and all original execution gates hold, consider the separately approved one-copy step. This investigation does not dispatch it.

concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.control: Repository Settings > Actions > General > Disable actions
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.impact: Temporarily pauses that repository's CI/automation; does not edit the successful package ACL.
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.restore: Restore the exact previously recorded Actions settings. Do not automatically rerun jobs.
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.limitations: Repository credentials with administration authority could restore the setting; already-issued token expiry must be separately established.

concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.control: Installed app Repository access restriction, or Suspend only if needed
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.scope: Only an app whose actual grant enables the competing path
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.impact: Potentially interrupts connected tools or deployments. Suspending ChatGPT Codex Connector would interrupt the current connector.
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.restore: Restore the exact selected repositories or Unsuspend via the owner's browser.
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.limitations: App authorization and unrelated tokens are separate; application-wide suspension is not automatically the minimum change.

concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.control: Fine-grained token repository/permission restriction, only if an indirect publication path is proven
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.scope: Only the relevant observed token permissions
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.impact: May pause its existing automation; no token deletion or rotation is planned.
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.restore: Restore recorded repository selection and permission values after separate approval as necessary.
concreteControlOptionsWithinSelectedMeth.limitations: Actual editability and affected scope remain unverified; no credential alteration is authorized.

uncontrollableOrUnproven: A package that does not yet exist has no observed candidate-specific precreation ACL.
A trusted account owner may create credentials or undo settings; the plan does not claim to defeat that authority.
Unknown token scopes and account sessions cannot be treated as blocked.
Already-issued tokens require actual expiry evidence; no immediate invalidation is assumed.
Unknown repository-creation privileges cannot be assumed unable to create an alternative token-issuing repository.
userNextAction: Provide only non-secret Repository access and Permissions sections from the two existing fine-grained token detail pages and the two installed app Configure pages, or resume once the remote browser service can read those pages. Do not change settings or supply codes/token values.
